mapper.select: SELECT g.group_id, g.group_name, g.challenge_type, g.base_deposit_amount, g.future_deposit_ratio_rule, g.min_count, ranked.success_count, ranked.rank_no, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws.week_no) FROM weekly_settlements ws WHERE ws.round_id = r.round_id AND ws.created_at <= NOW() ) AS completed_week_count, r.end_date AS round_end_date FROM group_users gu INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = gu.group_id INNER JOIN rounds r ON r.group_id = g.group_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT rh2.round_id, rh2.user_id, rh2.success_count, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY rh2.round_id ORDER BY rh2.success_count DESC ) AS rank_no FROM round_history rh2 ) ranked ON ranked.round_id = r.round_id AND ranked.user_id = gu.user_id WHERE gu.user_id = #{userId} AND gu.group_user_status = 'ACTIVE' AND g.group_status = 'ONGOING' AND r.round_status IN ('ONGOING', 'WAITING_SETTLEMENT') AND r.end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND r.end_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ORDER BY r.end_date ASC, g.group_id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(at.amount), 0) FROM account_transactions at WHERE at.transaction_category = 'SETTLEMENT' AND at.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND at.created_at < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND ( at.kb_account_id IN ( SELECT a.kb_account_id FROM accounts a INNER JOIN kb_accounts k ON k.kb_account_id = a.kb_account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND k.account_type = 'PENSION' ) OR at.another_account_number IN ( SELECT k.account_number FROM accounts a INNER JOIN kb_accounts k ON k.kb_account_id = a.kb_account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND k.account_type = 'PENSION' ) )
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(k.balance), 0) FROM accounts a INNER JOIN kb_accounts k ON k.kb_account_id = a.kb_account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND k.account_type = 'PENSION'
